# Ginés Sánchez

> Ginés Sánchez builds software and companies at Alteridad — technology that
> lowers the cost of sensing, understanding, and responding to one another.

Ginés builds software and companies at Alteridad, across people,
organisations, machines, and living systems. The work makes it cheaper to turn
what is known into action—and what happens next into a better decision;
shortens the path from understanding to action, and from consequences back to
the next decision; and makes truth easier to recover, decisions easier to
explain, and consequences harder to ignore. The long game is to make it easier
to create value together than to take it from somewhere else.

  working notes (September 1, 2026).
